instruction:
You are a senior civil engineer specializing in water infrastructure and pipe hydraulics.

## Problem

Verify that the flow velocity in a pipe meets the minimum and maximum velocity limits per AS/NZS 3500.1 for the given service type. Calculate the flow velocity and determine whether it complies with the applicable limits.

## Given

| Parameter | Value | Unit |
|-----------|-------|------|
| Pipe diameter (D) | {{ pipe_diameter_mm }} | mm |
| Flow rate (Q) | {{ flow_rate_l_s }} | L/s |
{%- if service_type is defined %}
| Service type | {{ service_type }} | - |
{%- endif %}
{%- if archetype_description is defined %}

### Site Conditions

{{ archetype_description }}
{% endif %}

{% if tool_available %}
## Available Tool

A pipe velocity calculation tool is available at `/workspace/pipe-velocity-check_calc.py`. Run it with:

```bash
python3 /workspace/pipe-velocity-check_calc.py --help
```

You may use this tool to verify your calculations or compute values directly.
{% endif %}

## Required

Calculate the following:

1. Flow velocity V (m/s)
2. Velocity compliance (1.0 if within limits, 0.0 if outside limits)

## Applicable Standards

- AS/NZS 3500.1 Clause 3.4 — velocity limits by service type

## Velocity Limits (AS/NZS 3500.1)

| Service Type | Min Velocity (m/s) | Max Velocity (m/s) |
|---|---|---|
| Water supply | 0.6 | 3.0 |
| Sewer (gravity) | 0.6 | 4.0 |
| Stormwater | 0.6 | 6.0 |
| Fire services | 0.5 | 4.0 |

## Constraints

- No internet access is available. Work from engineering knowledge and the provided tool.
- Use the following formulas:
  - Cross-sectional area: A = pi * (D/2)^2 where D is the diameter in metres (convert from mm)
  - Flow velocity: V = Q / A where Q is in m^3/s (convert from L/s by dividing by 1000)
  - Compliance: compare V against the min and max velocity for the given service type
- Compliance is 1.0 if min_velocity <= V <= max_velocity, otherwise 0.0

## Output Format

Show your step-by-step working in Markdown, including the unit conversions, area calculation, velocity calculation, and compliance check. At the end of your solution, include a JSON block with your final answers in exactly this format:

```json
{
  "velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "compliance": <numeric_value>
}
```

Write your complete solution to `/workspace/output.md`.
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "pipe-velocity-check"
description = "Pipe flow velocity compliance check against AS/NZS 3500.1 service-type limits"
long_description = "Calculates full-bore pipe flow velocity from V = Q/A and checks compliance against minimum and maximum velocity limits specified in AS/NZS 3500.1 for water supply, gravity sewer, stormwater, and fire service pipes. Ensures velocities remain within self-cleansing and scour-prevention bounds for the given service type."
discipline = "civil"
category = "pipe-hydraulics"
standards = ["AS/NZS 3500.1 Clause 3.4"]
tags = ["civil", "pipe-hydraulics", "velocity", "compliance", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

# --- Parameters ---

[params.pipe_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "Internal pipe diameter D"
min = 15
max = 1200

[params.flow_rate_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "Volumetric flow rate Q"
min = 0.1
max = 2000

[params.service_type]
type = "enum"
description = "Pipe service type per AS/NZS 3500.1"
values = ["water_supply", "sewer_gravity", "stormwater", "fire_services"]
derivable_from = "archetype"

# --- Outputs ---

[outputs.velocity_m_s]
description = "Flow velocity V (m/s)"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.compliance]
description = "Velocity compliance (1.0 = within limits, 0.0 = outside limits)"
tolerance = 0.01

# --- Archetypes ---

[archetypes.residential_water_supply]
description = "Residential water supply reticulation in PVC or copper"
pipe_diameter_mm = {min = 15, max = 100}
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 0.1, max = 10}
service_type = ["water_supply"]
site_contexts = ["sydney-suburban-estate", "brisbane-residential-infill"]

[archetypes.trunk_sewer]
description = "Trunk gravity sewer main in reinforced concrete or vitrified clay"
pipe_diameter_mm = {min = 225, max = 900}
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 10, max = 800}
service_type = ["sewer_gravity"]
site_contexts = ["melbourne-trunk-sewer", "adelaide-catchment-sewer"]

[archetypes.stormwater_main]
description = "Stormwater drainage main in reinforced concrete pipe"
pipe_diameter_mm = {min = 300, max = 1200}
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 50, max = 2000}
service_type = ["stormwater"]
site_contexts = ["perth-urban-drainage", "darwin-monsoon-drainage"]

[archetypes.fire_hydrant_main]
description = "Fire hydrant main in ductile iron or HDPE"
pipe_diameter_mm = {min = 100, max = 300}
flow_rate_l_s = {min = 5, max = 150}
service_type = ["fire_services"]
site_contexts = ["canberra-commercial-precinct", "hobart-industrial-park"]

# --- Difficulty ---

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All parameters given, water supply only, small residential pipes"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["residential_water_supply"]
service_type = ["water_supply"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All parameters given, any service type and pipe size"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["residential_water_supply", "trunk_sewer", "stormwater_main", "fire_hydrant_main"]

[difficulty.hard]
description = "Service type hidden, agent must infer from site description"
visibility = "partial"
hidden_params = ["service_type"]
replacement_text = "The pipe is {{ archetype.description }} serving {{ archetype.site_context }}"
archetypes = ["residential_water_supply", "trunk_sewer", "stormwater_main", "fire_hydrant_main"]
